english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone uses a car horn.

examples.english: When I see traffic backed up ahead, I honk the horn to ask the car in front to move forward a bit.
examples.traditional: 見到前面塞車，我就撳喇叭叫前面架車行開啲。
